column1: -- SELECT q.id,q.tracking_code,q.workflow_status,q.status,q.discount_approval_status,q.email,qi.sku_snapshot,qi.quantity,n.type,n.title FROM quotes q LEFT JOIN quote_items qi ON qi.quote_id=q.id LEFT JOIN notifications n ON n.link LIKE '%' || q.id || '%' WHERE q.id='CP-20260925-M4DP' ORDER BY n.created_at DESC;
